name: Depakar Business Hours
author: Depakar B

sections.description:
Depakar Business Hours adds a Business Hours tab to the Depakar Social Chat settings page.

  • Weekly schedule with opening and closing times per day
  • Closed-all-day option, overnight hours and 24-hour days
  • Uses your site timezone
  • Outside hours: hide the chat button, or show an offline version with its own text, link and colour
  • Works with page caching: the open or closed check runs in the visitor’s browser
  • Preview the offline state in the live preview before saving

Requires Depakar Social Chat (version 1.2.0 or later).
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Depakar Social Chat.
  2. Upload the folder depakar-business-hours to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate it.
  3. Open Depakar Social Chat in the admin menu and go to the Business Hours tab.
